```{r functions, include=FALSE}

# Numeric threshold from config: blank -> default; "none"/"off"/no -> NA (disabled)
# (same rule as merge_batches.qmd)
cfg_threshold <- function(x, default) {
  if (wf_is_blank(x)) return(default)
  if (is.logical(x)) return(if (isTRUE(x)) default else NA_real_)
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[1]))
  if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else v
}

# Dashed reference lines; nothing is drawn for a disabled (NA) threshold
threshold_lines <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NULL)
  geom_vline(xintercept = x, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick")
}

# Per-feature median log2 ratio used by the merge filter (centred per overlap
# sample); falls back to the raw ratio for diagnostics from older merge runs
l2r_col <- function(df) {
  if ("median_log2ratio_centered" %in% colnames(df)) "median_log2ratio_centered" else "median_log2ratio"
}

make_feature_subsets <- function(diag_df) {
  list(
    `Internal standard` = diag_df[grepl("istd", diag_df$table), , drop = FALSE],
    `With identity`     = diag_df[!grepl("istd", diag_df$table) & !is.na(diag_df$identity), , drop = FALSE],
    `Without identity`  = diag_df[!grepl("istd", diag_df$table) &  is.na(diag_df$identity), , drop = FALSE],
    `Overall`           = diag_df
  )
}

make_l2r_subsets <- function(l2r_df) {
  empty <- data.frame(table = character(), step = character(),
                      identity = character(), sample = character(),
                      log2ratio = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (is.null(l2r_df) || nrow(l2r_df) == 0)
    return(list(`Internal standard` = empty, `With identity` = empty,
                `Without identity`  = empty, `Overall`       = empty))
  is_istd   <- grepl("istd", l2r_df$table)
  has_id_col <- "identity" %in% colnames(l2r_df)
  list(
    `Internal standard` = l2r_df[ is_istd, , drop = FALSE],
    `With identity`     = if (has_id_col)
      l2r_df[!is_istd & !is.na(l2r_df$identity), , drop = FALSE]
    else
      l2r_df[!is_istd, , drop = FALSE],
    `Without identity`  = if (has_id_col)
      l2r_df[!is_istd &  is.na(l2r_df$identity), , drop = FALSE]
    else
      empty,
    `Overall`           = l2r_df
  )
}



plot_mz_hist <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) { cat("No data for this subset.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = mz_ppm)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    threshold_lines(thr_mz_ppm) +
    facet_grid(table ~ step, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(#title = "m/z difference for matched feature pairs",
         x = if (shift_corrected) "|m/z difference| after batch shift correction (ppm)"
             else "|m/z difference| (ppm)",
         y = "Nr. features")
  ggplotly(p)
}

plot_rt_hist <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) { cat("No data for this subset.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rt_diff)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "darkorange", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    threshold_lines(thr_rt_min) +
    facet_grid(table ~ step, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(#title = "RT difference for matched feature pairs",
         x = "|RT difference| (min)", y = "Nr. features")
  ggplotly(p)
}

plot_ccs_hist <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) { cat("No data for this subset.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ccs_percent)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "mediumpurple", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(table ~ step, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(#title = "RT difference for matched feature pairs",
         x = "ccs difference (%)", y = "Nr. features")
  ggplotly(p)
}


plot_cor_hist <- function(df) {
  d <- df[!is.na(df$overlap_cor), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) { cat("No overlap correlation data for this subset.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = overlap_cor)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "seagreen", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    threshold_lines(thr_cor) +
    facet_grid(table ~ step, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(#title = "Overlap sample Spearman correlation per feature (batch A vs batch B)",
         subtitle = if (is.na(thr_cor)) "Correlation filter disabled"
                    else paste0("Red dashed line: merge filter thres_cor = ", thr_cor),
         x = "Spearman r", y = "Nr. features")
  ggplotly(p)
}

print_cor_summary <- function(df) {
  d <- df[!is.na(df$overlap_cor), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  summ <- d |>
    group_by(table, step) |>
    summarise(
      n_features     = n(),
      median_cor     = round(median(overlap_cor, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      pct_cor_gte_09 = round(100 * mean(overlap_cor >= 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      pct_cor_lt_flag = round(100 * mean(overlap_cor < flag_cor, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  knitr::kable(
    summ,
    #caption = "Overlap sample Spearman correlation summary",
    col.names = c("Table", "Step", "Features", "Median cor", "% cor ≥ 0.9",
                  paste0("% cor < ", flag_cor, " (flag)"))
  )
}

plot_l2r_hist <- function(df) {
  col <- l2r_col(df)
  d <- df[!is.na(df[[col]]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) { cat("No log2 ratio data for this subset.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "mediumpurple", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    threshold_lines(c(-thr_log2ratio, thr_log2ratio)) +
    facet_grid(table ~ step, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(#title = "Median log2 ratio of overlap sample intensities (batch A / batch B)",
         subtitle = if (is.na(thr_log2ratio)) "log2 ratio filter disabled"
                    else paste0("Red dashed lines: merge filter thres_log2ratio = ±", thr_log2ratio),
         x = if (col == "median_log2ratio_centered")
               "Median log2(batch A / batch B), centred per overlap sample"
             else "Median log2(batch A / batch B)",
         y = "Nr. features")
  ggplotly(p)
}

plot_l2r_density <- function(l2r_df) {
  if (is.null(l2r_df) || nrow(l2r_df) == 0) {
    cat("No per-sample log2 ratio data available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  p <- 
    ggplot(l2r_df, aes(x = log2ratio)) +
    #geom_density(fill = NA, color = "steelblue4", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue4", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    #geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid") +
    threshold_lines(c(-thr_log2ratio, thr_log2ratio)) +
    facet_grid(table ~ step, scales = "free_y") +
    #coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 3)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(#title = "Log2 ratio of overlap sample intensities (batch A / batch B)",
         subtitle = "Per sample and feature, not centred; dashed lines: ±thres_log2ratio for reference",
         x = "log2(batch A / batch B)", y = "Nr. samples")
  ggplotly(p)
  #print(p)
}



show_flagged <- function(df) {
  col <- l2r_col(df)
  flagged <- df[
    (!is.na(df$overlap_cor) & df$overlap_cor < flag_cor) |
    (!is.na(df[[col]])      & abs(df[[col]]) > flag_log2ratio),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
    cat("No features flagged: all matched features pass the review levels.\n")
  } else {
    cat(nrow(flagged), "features flagged (overlap correlation <", flag_cor,
        "or |median log2 ratio| >", flag_log2ratio, ").\n\n")
    show_cols <- intersect(
      c("table", "step", "mz", "rt", "identity",
        "mz_ppm", "rt_diff", "overlap_cor", "median_log2ratio", "median_log2ratio_centered"),
      colnames(flagged)
    )
    
    # knitr::kable(
    #   flagged[order(flagged$overlap_cor), show_cols, drop = FALSE],
    #   #caption = "Flagged features — sorted by overlap_cor ascending (up to 100 shown)",
    #   digits  = 4
    # )
    
    datatable(
      flagged[order(flagged$overlap_cor), show_cols, drop = FALSE],
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 15,
        autoWidth = TRUE,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
      ),
      filter = "top",
      rownames = FALSE
    )
  }
}



plot_pca <- function(tbl, sample_batch_map, title) {
  if (is.null(tbl) || nrow(tbl) == 0) { cat("No data available.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  int_cols <- if (any(grepl("\\.d\\.area$", colnames(tbl)))) {
    grep("\\.d\\.area$", colnames(tbl), value = TRUE)
  } else {
    grep("(?<!\\.rt|\\.mz)\\.d$", colnames(tbl), value = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  }
  if (length(int_cols) < 3) { cat("Insufficient sample columns for PCA.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  mat <- t(as.matrix(tbl[, int_cols, drop = FALSE]))
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  mat <- log2(mat + 1)
  col_var <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat <- mat[, col_var > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(mat) < 2) { cat("Insufficient variable features for PCA.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  pca  <- prcomp(mat, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  pct  <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)
  snames <- sub("^datafile\\.", "", rownames(pca$x))
  snames <- sub("\\.d\\.area$|\\.d$|\\.mzML$", "", snames)
  batch_vals <- sample_batch_map[snames]
  batch_vals[is.na(batch_vals)] <- 0L
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1    = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2    = pca$x[, 2],
    sample = snames,
    batch  = factor(paste0("Batch ", batch_vals),
                    levels = paste0("Batch ", sort(unique(batch_vals)))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = batch, label = sample)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = paste0("PC1 (", pct[1], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", pct[2], "%)"),
         color = "Batch")
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("label", "color", "x", "y"))
}

```

## Inputs

```{r inputs}

cfg         <- wf_read_yaml_config(params$config, label = "params$config")
path_result <- wf_cfg_required(cfg, "path_result")
  
overlap_names <- if (!wf_is_blank(cfg$overlap_by_name)) {
  trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(cfg$overlap_by_name), ",", fixed = TRUE)))
} else {
  character(0)
}

diag_path <- file.path(path_result, "data", "merge_diagnostics.rds")
if (!file.exists(diag_path))
  stop("Merge diagnostics not found: ", diag_path,
       "\nRun merge_batches before evaluate_merge.")

diag             <- readRDS(diag_path)
all_diag         <- diag$all_diag
all_counts       <- diag$all_counts
all_funnel       <- diag$all_funnel
all_l2r          <- diag$all_l2r
all_input_counts <- diag$all_input_counts
n_final_per_tbl  <- diag$n_final

if (is.null(all_diag) || nrow(all_diag) == 0)
  stop("No alignment diagnostics found in ", diag_path)

# Merged peaktables for PCA
tbl_paths <- list(
  pos      = cfg$path_peaktable_pos,
  neg      = cfg$path_peaktable_neg,
  istd_pos = cfg$path_peaktable_istd_pos,
  istd_neg = cfg$path_peaktable_istd_neg
)
merged_tables <- lapply(tbl_paths, function(p) {
  if (wf_is_blank(p) || !file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  openxlsx::read.xlsx(p)
})

# Sample to batch map
sample_batch_map <- if (!is.null(diag$sample_batch_map) && length(diag$sample_batch_map) > 0) {
  diag$sample_batch_map
} else {
  warning("sample_batch_map not found in diagnostics RDS — re-run merge_batches to enable batch colouring")
  integer(0)
}

# Feature subsets
feat_subsets <- make_feature_subsets(all_diag)
l2r_subsets  <- make_l2r_subsets(all_l2r)

# Merge thresholds (same config keys and defaults as merge_batches.qmd), used for
# the reference lines in the plots
thr_mz_ppm      <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_mz_ppm, 3)
thr_rt_min      <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_rt_min, 0.1)
thr_cor         <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_cor, 0.7)
thr_log2ratio   <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_log2ratio, 0.3)
shift_corrected <- !is.null(all_funnel) &&
  (if (wf_is_blank(cfg$shift_correction)) TRUE else wf_as_flag(cfg$shift_correction))

# Review levels for the flagged-features tables: stricter than the merge filters,
# so they list accepted matches worth a second look
flag_cor        <- cfg_threshold(cfg$flag_cor, 0.8)
flag_log2ratio  <- cfg_threshold(cfg$flag_log2ratio, 0.1)
if (is.na(flag_cor))       flag_cor       <- -Inf
if (is.na(flag_log2ratio)) flag_log2ratio <- Inf

cat("Config:                   ", params$config, "\n")
cat("Merge thresholds:          m/z", thr_mz_ppm, "ppm, RT", thr_rt_min, "min, cor",
    if (is.na(thr_cor)) "off" else thr_cor, ", log2ratio",
    if (is.na(thr_log2ratio)) "off" else thr_log2ratio, "\n")
cat("Flag levels:               cor <", flag_cor, ", |log2ratio| >", flag_log2ratio, "\n")
cat("Overlap samples specified:", length(overlap_names), "\n")
cat("Table types:              ", paste(unique(all_diag$table), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Samples mapped to batches:", length(sample_batch_map), "\n")

```

## Alignment diagnostics

### Feature counts

```{r feature_counts, fig.height=4}

merged_counts <- data.frame(
  table    = names(n_final_per_tbl),
  label    = "merged",
  features = unname(n_final_per_tbl),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

count_plot_df <- rbind(all_input_counts, merged_counts)
input_levels  <- sort(unique(all_input_counts$label))
count_plot_df$label <- factor(count_plot_df$label, levels = c(input_levels, "merged"))

p_counts <- ggplot(count_plot_df, aes(x = label, y = features, fill = ifelse(label == "merged", "After merge", "Before merge"),
                                      text = paste0(label, ": ", features))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before merge" = "steelblue", "After merge" = "seagreen")) +
  facet_wrap(~table, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(#title = "Feature counts: input batches vs merged output",
       x = NULL, y = "Nr. features")
ggplotly(p_counts, tooltip = "text")

```

### Batch shifts and matching funnel

Systematic m/z and RT offset of each batch relative to b1, estimated from uniquely
annotated features (`anchors`) and removed before matching. The remaining columns
show how many reference features are left after each filter step.

```{r batch_shifts}

if (is.null(all_funnel) || nrow(all_funnel) == 0) {
  cat("No shift/funnel information in the diagnostics (merge run with an older merge_batches).\n")
} else {
  fun_df <- all_funnel
  rownames(fun_df) <- NULL
  knitr::kable(
    fun_df,
    col.names = c("Table", "Step", "Shift (ppm)", "Shift (min)", "Anchors",
                  "Reference features", "Batch features", "m/z + RT match",
                  "Identity OK", "Correlation OK", "log2 ratio OK", "Merged")
  )
}

```

```{r batch_shift_plot, fig.height=3.5}

if (!is.null(all_funnel) && nrow(all_funnel) > 0) {
  # ISTD tables reuse the shifts of their main table, so only main tables are shown
  sh <- all_funnel[!grepl("istd", all_funnel$table), c("table", "step", "shift_ppm", "shift_rt")]
  if (nrow(sh) == 0) sh <- all_funnel[, c("table", "step", "shift_ppm", "shift_rt")]
  sh <- rbind(data.frame(table = unique(sh$table), step = "b1", shift_ppm = 0, shift_rt = 0), sh)
  sh$batch <- sub(".*→", "", sh$step)
  sh$batch <- factor(sh$batch, levels = unique(sh$batch[order(as.integer(sub("^b", "", sh$batch)))]))
  p_shift <- ggplot(sh, aes(x = batch, y = shift_ppm,
                            text = paste0(table, " ", batch, ": ", round(shift_ppm, 2), " ppm, ",
                                          round(shift_rt * 60, 1), " s"))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    facet_wrap(~table) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "m/z shift vs b1 (ppm)")
  ggplotly(p_shift, tooltip = "text")
}

```

```{r pca_noid, fig.height=5}
pos_noid <- if (!is.null(merged_tables$pos) && "identity" %in% colnames(merged_tables$pos))
  merged_tables$pos[ is.na(merged_tables$pos$identity), , drop = FALSE] else NULL

plot_pca(pos_noid, sample_batch_map, "PCA — positive mode (unknown features)")

```

```{r pca_noid2, fig.height=5}
neg_noid <- if (!is.null(merged_tables$neg) && "identity" %in% colnames(merged_tables$neg))
  merged_tables$neg[ is.na(merged_tables$neg$identity), , drop = FALSE] else NULL

plot_pca(neg_noid, sample_batch_map, "PCA — negative mode (unknown features)")
```

### Overall

```{r pca_all, fig.height=5}
plot_pca(merged_tables$pos, sample_batch_map, "PCA — positive mode (all features)")
```

```{r pca_all2, fig.height=5}
plot_pca(merged_tables$neg, sample_batch_map, "PCA — negative mode (all features)")
```
